summary.text: Quentin Gee is the Democratic candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 68, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Clint Owlett.
A U.S. Marine Corps and Army veteran, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities are rural health care, mental health, gun rights and limits on hyperscale data centers.

paragraphs.text: Quentin Gee served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1996 to 2001 and graduated from Dallastown Area High School, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a combat veteran with 11 years of combined service in the Marine Corps and Army and as a blue-collar union worker.
Gee's survey response names rural health care, including charity care from nonprofit health systems, and mental health resources as his top priorities, followed by Second Amendment rights.
He also said he opposes hyperscale data center development in rural Pennsylvania and supports bringing union manufacturing jobs to the area.
